name: Fire Rune

automation.text:
You touch a melee weapon and place a magical effect into it, creating a visible rune etched into the weapon. Attacks made by the invoked weapon deal an extra 1d8 Fire damage on a hit.

Use `-d 1d8[fire]` to add extra damage to an attack.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
